title: Shared: field-photo limits, resize targets and pure allowance helper
description: [Phase A (no overlap with #542/#543/#544)] Add constants to shared/upload.js (keep existing exports untouched): MAX_FIELD_PHOTOS=10 (approved per field), MAX_PENDING_PHOTOS_PER_USER_PER_FIELD=5, MAX_PENDING_PHOTOS_PER_USER=15, MAX_PHOTO_UPLOADS_PER_DAY=20, IMAGE_RESIZE_MAX_EDGE=1600, IMAGE_RESIZE_JPEG_QUALITY=0.82. Add a pure function computeFieldPhotoAllowance({ isAdmin, approvedCountForField, userPendingForField, userPendingTotal, userUploadsLast24h, requested }) returning { allowed, remaining, reason } where reason is one of null | 'FIELD_FULL' | 'PENDING_PER_FIELD' | 'PENDING_TOTAL' | 'DAILY'. Rules: admins skip the three per-user limits; the 10-approved-per-field cap is a hard cap for everyone (admin uploads are auto-approved so remaining = 10 - approved; for users, FIELD_FULL when approved >= 10); remaining for users = min(5 - pendingForField, 15 - pendingTotal, 20 - uploadsLast24h), floored at 0; allowed = min(requested, remaining); reason names the binding limit when allowed < requested. Also add validateFieldPhotoFile({ mimetype, size }) returning null | 'TYPE' | 'SIZE' using the existing MIME_EXTENSIONS / MAX_IMAGE_FILE_SIZE. Add types to upload.d.ts. Jest tests (same style as the other shared/*.test.js): each limit binding on its own, combined limits, admin exemption, field-full for users and admins, trimming a multi-select (requested 6, remaining 3 -> allowed 3), zero/negative guards, type and size validation. Then run `node server/scripts/sync-shared.js` so the generated server/shared/upload.js is regenerated (generated file, commit it; do not hand-edit). Do NOT touch shared/package.json or sync-shared.js (both are in #543) - upload.js is already exported and synced. [As built: computeResizedDimensions, planFieldPhotoBatch and fieldPhotoErrorKind also live in shared/upload.js so web and mobile share one tested copy. planFieldPhotoBatch checks type only - file size is checked on the resized copy, because a 12MB phone photo is well under 5MB after the resize.]

title: Web: client-side resize utility with tests
description: [Phase A] New util. computeResizedDimensions(width, height, maxEdge) is pure (never upscales, keeps aspect ratio, rounds to integers) and is what the Jest test covers (landscape, portrait, square, already-small, extreme aspect). resizeImageFile(file: File): Promise<File> decodes with createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: 'from-image' }) (fallback: HTMLImageElement), draws to a canvas at the computed size, exports JPEG at IMAGE_RESIZE_JPEG_QUALITY via canvas.toBlob, and returns a File named <original>.jpg. Constants come from @joinup/shared/upload. GIFs are flattened to their first frame (acceptable for field photos). If decoding fails, or the result is larger than the original and the original is already within the max edge, return the original file unchanged so the server check stays the single gate.

title: Web: field-photos API client and multi-file upload hook
description: [Phase A] New API client in its own file (next_app/src/services/api/fields.ts is in #542 - do not touch). Types: FieldPhoto { id, url, status: 'PENDING'|'APPROVED'|'REJECTED', sortOrder, isMine?, createdAt }, FieldPhotosResponse { photos: FieldPhoto[] (approved, ordered), mine: FieldPhoto[] (viewer's own pending, empty for guests), remaining: number | null (null for guests), fieldFull: boolean }. Methods: list(fieldId, token?) - with a token it must send `cache: 'no-store'`; upload(fieldId, file, token, onProgress) using XMLHttpRequest so per-file upload progress is real (fetch has no upload progress); removeMine(fieldId, photoId, token); admin: listPending(token), approve(photoId, token), reject(photoId, token), remove(photoId, token), reorder(fieldId, orderedIds, token). Follow the existing multipart pattern in services/api/fields.ts addPhoto (form field name 'photo'). Hook useFieldPhotoUpload(fieldId, remaining): takes a FileList, runs validateFieldPhotoFile per file, trims to `remaining` and reports how many were not sent (never silently drops: returns { skippedCount } and per-file items), then for each file sequentially: resizeImageFile -> upload, exposing items [{ id, name, previewUrl, status: 'queued'|'resizing'|'uploading'|'done'|'error', progress 0-100, errorKind }], plus retry(itemId) and dismiss(itemId). Map server 409/429 limit responses (error code in body) to errorKind so the UI can show the specific message. Revoke object URLs on cleanup.

title: Web: FieldGallery carousel, fullscreen viewer and empty state
description: [Phase A] New client components in MUI, matching the existing field page card (Card with overflow hidden, 220px hero that grows to ~320px at md+). FieldGallery props: { fieldId, fieldName, initialPhotos: string[] (SSR approved urls so the first image paints without a client fetch), signedIn }. Layout: horizontal scroll container with CSS scroll-snap (scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; each slide 100% width, snap-align: center), dir inherited so RTL works natively; compute the active index with an IntersectionObserver on the slides (do NOT derive it from scrollLeft - its sign differs across browsers in RTL). Overlay: dots (max 10) plus an 'n / total' counter chip; previous/next IconButtons shown on hover/focus at md+, using scrollIntoView on the target slide, with mirrored icons in RTL. Images: first slide eager, the rest loading='lazy' decoding='async', MUI Skeleton placeholder until onLoad, SafeImage fallback on error; request Cloudinary-transformed URLs (insert f_auto,q_auto,w_1200 after /image/upload/ only when the URL is on res.cloudinary.com; leave other URLs untouched). Alt text: '<fieldName> - תמונה n מתוך total'. The viewer's own pending photos appear after the approved ones with a 'ממתינה לאישור' badge and reduced opacity, and a small remove button. Single photo: no dots/arrows. Empty state (no approved, no pending): the default-field image dimmed with a centered 'עדיין אין תמונות למגרש' line and a contained 'הוסיפו תמונה ראשונה' button (signed-in) or a sign-in prompt (guest). Tap/Enter on a slide opens FieldPhotoViewer: fullScreen MUI Dialog, black background, same scroll-snap strip starting at the tapped index, object-fit contain, close button, counter, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (direction-aware) and Esc; aria-label 'גלריית תמונות - <fieldName>'; focus returns to the opening slide. Carousel region: role='region', aria-roledescription='carousel', aria-label; slides role='group' aria-label 'n מתוך total'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (scroll-behavior auto). Web is Hebrew-only today (no i18n layer exists in next_app), so strings are Hebrew literals like the rest of the page.

title: Web: multi-file 'add photos' uploader with per-file progress
description: [Phase A] New FieldPhotoUploader: button 'הוספת תמונות' + hidden <input type='file' multiple accept={ACCEPTED_IMAGE_TYPES}>; on select calls useFieldPhotoUpload. Shows a compact list (inside a Dialog on mobile widths, inline under the gallery at md+) with one row per file: thumbnail, name, LinearProgress (determinate while uploading, indeterminate while resizing), a success tick, or an error line with 'נסו שוב' / dismiss. Messages: before picking, a helper line 'אפשר להוסיף עוד N תמונות' from `remaining`; when a selection is trimmed, an Alert 'נבחרו X תמונות, אפשר להוסיף עוד N. Y לא נשלחו' (nothing silently dropped); per-file errors for wrong type, over 5MB, daily limit, pending limit, gallery full, network. After all finish: 'התמונות נשלחו לאישור' (or 'התמונות נוספו' for admins) and the gallery refetches so the uploader's pending photos appear with the badge. Button disabled with an explanatory tooltip when remaining is 0. aria-live='polite' on the status region; every icon button labelled. Wire the uploader into FieldGallery (header action + empty-state button).

title: Web admin: pending-photos queue on the admin fields page
description: [Phase A] New panel modelled on FieldSuggestionsPanel (read it for layout/behaviour, do NOT edit it - it is in #542). Lists pending photos grouped by field: thumbnail (click to enlarge), field name linking to /fields/<id>, uploader name, date, and the field's current approved count 'n/10'. Actions: approve, reject (both optimistic with rollback and a snackbar on failure); approve is disabled with a reason when the field already has 10 approved. Count badge in the panel heading; empty state 'אין תמונות שממתינות לאישור'. Mount it in next_app/src/app/admin/fields/page.tsx next to the existing suggestions panel (this page is not in any open PR).

title: Mobile: field-photos API client and FieldGallery with fullscreen viewer
description: [Phase A] New API client in its own file (mobile_app/src/services/api/fields.ts is in #543 - do not touch; reuse its exported uploadMultipart/PickedImage if exported, otherwise replicate the small multipart helper locally). Same response shape as the web client in step 3. FieldGallery: horizontal FlatList with pagingEnabled, item width = container width from onLayout, getItemLayout, initialNumToRender 1, windowSize 3 (off-screen photos are not loaded); images via expo-image (already installed) with contentFit='cover', a neutral placeholder colour and transition={150}, recyclingKey per url, Cloudinary f_auto,q_auto,w_1080 transform on res.cloudinary.com URLs only. Height 220. Dots + 'n / total' counter overlay; active index from onViewableItemsChanged (not from scroll offset, which is unreliable under RTL). RTL: let FlatList follow I18nManager.isRTL - do not use `inverted`; verify order visually on the emulator. Own pending photos appended with a 'pending review' badge. Empty state: tinted panel with a camera icon, t('fieldPhotos.emptyTitle') and a primary 'add first photo' button (sign-in prompt for guests) - styled with the existing NativeWind tokens used on the field screen (bg-white dark:bg-cyber-card, brand-* colours). Tap opens FieldPhotoViewer: full-screen Modal, black background, paged FlatList at the tapped index, contentFit='contain', close button respecting safe-area insets, counter, Android back closes. Accessibility: each image accessibilityLabel t('fieldPhotos.photoAlt', { name, index, total }), accessibilityRole='image'; buttons labelled; the list has accessibilityRole='adjustable' with a label. All strings via t('fieldPhotos.*', '<Hebrew default>') - the existing fallback-default pattern - so this step does not touch he.json/en.json (both are in #543 and #544); locale entries are added in step 15.

title: Mobile: multi-select picker and upload sheet with per-file progress
description: [Phase A] pickFieldPhotos(remaining): same permission handling as utils/pickImage.ts (iOS asks, Android system picker needs none) but launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['images'], allowsMultipleSelection: true, selectionLimit: Math.min(remaining, 10), quality: 1 }) - quality 1 because resize/compression now happens in the resize step, not the picker. Returns all picked assets plus per-asset validation results (type/size via validateFieldPhotoFile) instead of alerting and returning null, so one bad file does not cancel the batch. Hook mirrors the web hook from step 3: trim to remaining and report skippedCount, then per file resize -> upload sequentially with status and progress (use XMLHttpRequest upload.onprogress, which React Native supports, for real per-file progress), retry and dismiss. The resize call goes through an injected `resize` function imported from '@/utils/resizeImage' - that module is created in step 12 (it needs the expo-image-manipulator install, which touches mobile_app/package.json, currently in #544). So in this step do not import that module: give the hook an optional `resize` parameter that defaults to identity, and step 12 wires the real one. FieldPhotoUploadSheet: bottom-sheet style Modal consistent with existing sheets in the app, rows with thumbnail, progress bar, tick or error + retry; header line t('fieldPhotos.remaining', { count }); trimmed-selection notice; final 'sent for review' confirmation. accessibilityLiveRegion='polite' on the status text.

Add an entry row with a pending-count badge on mobile_app/app/admin/index.tsx and register the route in _layout.tsx if the layout lists screens explicitly. None of these files are in an open PR.

title: Schema: FieldPhoto model, additive migration with idempotent backfill
description: [Phase B (after #542 and #543 are merged into Dev; rebase first)] Read server/docs/agents/database_rules.md first. Add enum FieldPhotoStatus { PENDING APPROVED REJECTED } and model FieldPhoto { id String @id @default(cuid()); fieldId String; url String; status FieldPhotoStatus @default(PENDING); sortOrder Int @default(0); uploadedById String?; createdAt DateTime @default(now()); reviewedAt DateTime?; reviewedById String?; field Field @relation(onDelete: Cascade); uploadedBy User? @relation(onDelete: SetNull); @@unique([fieldId, url]); @@index([fieldId, status, sortOrder]); @@index([uploadedById, status]); @@index([uploadedById, createdAt]); @@index([status, createdAt]) } plus the back-relations on Field and User. Additive only: Field.image and Field.photos are NOT dropped or modified. Migration SQL = CREATE TYPE / CREATE TABLE / indexes / FKs, then the backfill, inserts only and idempotent via ON CONFLICT (fieldId, url) DO NOTHING: (1) every Field with a non-empty trimmed image -> one APPROVED row, sortOrder 0, uploadedById NULL, createdAt = Field.createdAt; (2) every element of Field.photos via unnest(...) WITH ORDINALITY -> APPROVED rows with sortOrder = ordinality (so they follow the cover), skipping empty strings and the url already inserted as the cover. Row ids: generate with a deterministic expression (e.g. 'fp_' || md5(fieldId || url)) since cuid() is not available in SQL. No UPDATE or DELETE statements anywhere in the migration. Apply to the Dev database only via the normal migrate flow in docs/agents/dev-env.md; never run against production from this task. Layer isolation: no UI files in this step. [As built: migration 20261111120000_add_field_photos, ordered after 20261110120000_add_field_parking. The backfill skips the stock placeholder image that field creation fills in when no photo is given, so those fields show the add-first-photo invitation. Verified on a disposable local Postgres: backfill result, idempotent re-run, no schema drift.]

title: Server: field-photos routes with limits, optional auth and private caching
description: [Phase B] Read .cursor/rules/server-invariants.mdc and testing-jest.mdc first. New router mounted in server/index.js next to the field-suggestions mount (use the single shared Prisma client, the same authenticateToken/requireAdmin and createRateLimiter as routes/fieldSuggestions.js, and createImageUpload('fields') + handleSingleUpload from middleware/upload.js - no new infrastructure). Endpoints: GET /api/fields/:id/photos - optional auth (grep server/utils/auth.js for an existing optional variant; if none exists, add a small local wrapper that runs authenticateToken only when an Authorization header is present and treats a missing header as guest, but still 401s on a present-but-invalid token). Response { photos (APPROVED, by sortOrder), mine (viewer's own PENDING, [] for guests), remaining (null for guests, else computeFieldPhotoAllowance(...).remaining), fieldFull }. Never return other users' pending/rejected rows or uploader ids to non-admins. Caching: when the request is authenticated set 'Cache-Control: private, no-store' and 'Vary: Authorization'; guest responses may keep the default. POST /api/fields/:id/photos/submit (a distinct path, so it does not collide with the legacy admin POST /api/fields/:id/photos in routes/fields.js): authenticateToken, hourly rate limiter (prefix 'field-photo', sized so a full 10-file batch passes: max 30/hour), reject users with blockedFromFieldSocial, then handleSingleUpload(…, 'photo') one file per request. Inside a transaction: load the four counts, call computeFieldPhotoAllowance({ requested: 1 }); if allowed is 0 respond 409 with { error, code: reason } (the central 4xx handler in handleSingleUpload already discards the stored file); else create the row - PENDING for users, APPROVED with sortOrder = max+1 for admins. The daily count uses FieldPhoto rows by uploadedById with createdAt in the last 24h (rejected rows are kept as rows so the daily count holds; only their file is deleted). DELETE /api/fields/:id/photos/:photoId - uploader may delete their own PENDING photo; admin may delete any; deletes the stored file via deleteUploadedFile. Admin: GET /api/field-photos/pending; POST /api/field-photos/:id/approve (409 FIELD_FULL when the field already has 10 approved; sets sortOrder = max+1, reviewedAt/By); POST /api/field-photos/:id/reject (status REJECTED, delete the stored file, keep the row); PUT /api/fields/:id/photos/order { orderedIds } (must be exactly the field's approved ids; rewrite sortOrder 0..n-1 in one transaction). Cover sync: after any approve / delete / reorder / admin upload, in the same transaction set Field.image to the first approved photo's url (or null), so the ~8 existing readers of field.image keep working unchanged. Tests (run only this file: cd server && PORT=3099 npx jest tests/fieldPhotos.test.js --runInBand --detectOpenHandles --forceExit): guest sees approved only; uploader sees own pending, another user does not; authenticated GET carries Cache-Control private, no-store; wrong type 400, oversize 413; each limit returns 409 with the right code; approve/reject frees a pending slot; admin exempt from per-user limits but not from the 10 cap; reorder validates the id set; cover sync after approve, reorder and delete; blocked user 403. [As built: a user withdrawing their own pending photo marks it REJECTED rather than deleting the row, so withdrawing cannot refill the daily count. A precheck runs before the file is stored. Shared helpers live in server/utils/fieldPhotos.js. Tests stub Prisma like fieldSuggestions.test.js.]

title: Mobile: add expo-image-manipulator and real client-side resize
description: [Phase B (after #544 is merged, it edits mobile_app/package.json)] Install with `npx expo install expo-image-manipulator` inside mobile_app so the version is the one aligned with the installed Expo SDK 54 (do not pin a version by hand). New util resizeImage(asset: { uri, width, height }): resize so the long edge is at most IMAGE_RESIZE_MAX_EDGE (never upscale; skip the resize action when already smaller) and save as JPEG with compress IMAGE_RESIZE_JPEG_QUALITY, returning a PickedImage { uri, name: '<base>.jpg', type: 'image/jpeg' }. Keep the dimension maths identical to the web computeResizedDimensions from step 2 (which is the tested copy). Making this util the default `resize` in useFieldPhotoUpload is a one-line change done in step 14, to stay within three files here. This is a native module: it needs the next native build and must NOT be shipped by OTA to existing builds - no store build or OTA is produced by this task.

title: Web wiring: gallery on the field page, reorder in the admin editor
description: [Phase B] Field page (lines ~118-134 today): replace the single SafeImage banner with <FieldGallery fieldId fieldName initialPhotos signedIn={!!userId} />. initialPhotos comes from a guest (no token) server fetch of GET /api/fields/:id/photos so the SSR HTML only ever contains approved photos and stays safely cacheable; the viewer's own pending photos are fetched client-side by FieldGallery with the token and cache: 'no-store'. Fall back to [field.image] when the photos fetch fails. Admin FieldPhotoGallery: switch from fieldsApi.addPhoto/removePhoto to the fieldPhotos client (multi-file add via the same hook, remove by id), and add reorder with 'move earlier' / 'move later' icon buttons per thumbnail (keyboard accessible, labelled, first/last disabled) calling the reorder endpoint; mark the first thumbnail as 'תמונה ראשית'. FieldEditorDialog: remove the separate single cover-image upload slot, since the cover is now simply the first gallery photo; keep everything else. Then run the next_app typecheck/build and jest.

Then run mobile_app typecheck and lint.

Add a fieldPhotos.* block to both locale files covering every key used in steps 7-9 and 14: gallery label, photoAlt ('{{name}} - photo {{index}} of {{total}}'), counter, pendingBadge ('ממתינה לאישור' / 'Pending review'), emptyTitle, addFirst, addPhotos, remaining (with plural forms), trimmed, sentForReview, added, per-error messages (type, size, daily, pendingField, pendingTotal, fieldFull, network), retry, remove, close, admin queue strings, moveEarlier/moveLater, mainPhoto. title: End-to-end verification on Dev (web + Android emulator)
description: [Phase B] No code. With the Dev test accounts from docs/agents/dev-env.md (never production): as a regular user upload a multi-file batch on web and see per-file progress, the trimmed-selection message, and own photos with the pending badge; as a second user and as a guest confirm those pending photos are not visible; as admin approve / reject / reorder and confirm the cover on field cards follows the first photo; confirm a field that had only the old single image shows it as photo 1 after the migration. Check RTL swipe direction, dots, fullscreen viewer, keyboard navigation and the empty state at mobile and desktop widths. Mobile: run on the Android emulator only if `adb-device list` shows no other agent using it; the new native module needs a local dev build, not OTA. Capture screenshots of web and mobile for the design review. Gates: next_app typecheck/build + jest, mobile_app typecheck + lint, shared jest, server jest for tests/fieldPhotos.test.js only (full suite is left to CI).
